terms.decision: Means a member has no duty not to enter the public reading area; do not express this as a general absence of duties on others.
Means a claim under Rule 2 against the manager for one standard seat during the two confirmed hours.
Under the original lecture, it is established when the success receipt is issued; it is not equivalent to clicking to reserve or to 'application received.'
Means termination of the reservation claim and duty of provision under Rule 3's conditions; membership and permission to enter do not end.
Retain both terms from the original class, treating each as the managing party under the corresponding rule; do not infer additional differences in occupational authority.
